function.name: composio_search/COMPOSIO_SEARCH_SCHOLAR
function.description: Scholar API allows you to scrape results from a Google Scholar search query. The ScholarSearch class performs an academic search using the Composio Scholar Search API, academic papers and scholarly articles. It uses the Google Scholar search engine through the SERP API to fetch relevant academic information based on the input query.

query.title: Query
query.description: The search query for the Composio Scholar Search API, specifying the academic topic or paper title.

function.name: alexcz-a11y/jina-httpstreamable/search_arxiv
function.description: Search academic papers and preprints on arXiv repository. Perfect for finding research papers, scientific studies, technical papers, and academic literature. Use this when researching scientific topics, looking for papers by specific authors, or finding the latest research in fields like AI, physics, mathematics, computer science, etc.

num.description: Maximum number of academic papers to return, between 1-100

tbs.description: Time-based search parameter, e.g., 'qdr:h' for past hour, can be qdr:h, qdr:d, qdr:w, qdr:m, qdr:y

query.description: Academic search terms, author names, or research topics (e.g., 'transformer neural networks', 'Einstein relativity', 'machine learning optimization'). Can be a single query string or an array of queries for parallel search.

function.name: alexcz-a11y/jina-httpstreamable/parallel_search_arxiv
function.description: Run multiple arXiv searches in parallel for comprehensive research coverage and diverse academic angles. For best results, provide multiple search queries that explore different research angles and methodologies. You can use expand_query to help generate diverse queries, or create them yourself.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for all searches

num.description: Maximum number of academic papers to return, between 1-100

tbs.description: Time-based search parameter, e.g., 'qdr:h' for past hour

query.description: Academic search terms, author names, or research topics

searches.description: Array of arXiv search configurations to execute in parallel (maximum 5 searches for optimal performance)

function.description: Search academic papers from CrossRef database. It's one of the largest citation databases covering millions of academic papers, journals, books, and other scholarly content. Args: query: Search query string (e.g., 'machine learning', 'climate change'). max_results: Maximum number of papers to return (default: 10, max: 1000). **kwargs: Additional search

function.description: Get a specific paper from CrossRef by its DOI. Args: doi: Digital Object Identifier (e.g., '10.1038/nature12373'). Returns: Paper metadata in dictionary format, or empty dict if not found. Example: get_crossref_paper_by_doi("10.1038/nature12373")
